subject.title: fix embedded compaction hook reset API

question: Should after-compaction plugin hooks gain the scoped `ctx.api.resetSession(reason?)` contract once all native harnesses use lifecycle-owned queues?
rationale: This is a new plugin API with session-state authority; code review can establish safety defects, but cannot decide whether this permanent external contract belongs in the supported hook surface.

options.title: Approve scoped API
options.body: Approve the current-session-only after-compaction API after native queue ownership, focused compatibility tests, and real lifecycle proof are complete.

options.title: Keep hooks observational
options.body: Do not add a reset method to hook contexts and require reset policy to remain in core or an existing owner-controlled session workflow.

options.title: Narrow native support
options.body: Ship the API only on lifecycle paths with proven owner queues and leave it absent from Codex and Copilot until their callers are wired safely.

recommendation.title: Approve scoped API
recommendation.body: Approve the current-session-only after-compaction API after native queue ownership, focused compatibility tests, and real lifecycle proof are complete.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest feature-history signal is the earlier compaction/reset plugin-hook contract work.
